verdict.rationale: Graphite ships an official, documented `gt` CLI. It installs via Homebrew or npm and has a command reference that includes AI-relevant safety affordances such as `--dry-run` on `gt absorb` and multi-worktree support. Community users report relying on it daily, and GT MCP extends stacking workflows to AI agents. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable (JSON) output or non-interactive modes aimed specifically at agent-driven CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
